_about: Image slots for the dental site. To supply an image, place files under public/dental-preview/assets/img/ and set 'src' (and 'src_mobile' where a mobile crop exists) plus 'status'. While 'src' is null the build renders a styled placeholder with the same fixed aspect ratio, so swapping in real images causes no layout shift. status: placeholder | illustrative-sample | authentic-approved. Illustrative samples must never depict someone presented as a real clinician or patient.

hero-clinic.label: The clinic, in natural light
appears_on: Home hero (right column desktop, above headline on mobile)
hero-clinic.subject: Calm, naturally lit view of the actual clinic: reception or treatment room, no patients in the chair
hero-clinic.text_safe_area: No text is overlaid; keep the key subject within the central 70% so both crops work
hero-clinic.alt_guidance: Describe the real space, e.g. 'The treatment room at the Clifton practice'. Don't mention smiles or outcomes.

team-portrait-*.label: Current clinician portrait
team-portrait-*.subject: One portrait per current clinician, consistent background and lighting across the team
team-portrait-*.text_safe_area: No overlay; head and shoulders in the upper two-thirds
team-portrait-*.alt_guidance: 'Portrait of Dr. <Full Name>' — name exactly as registered

team-group.label: The current team, together
team-group.subject: The actual current team together at the clinic
team-group.text_safe_area: No overlay; leave ~10% margin at the sides for the 4:3 mobile crop
team-group.alt_guidance: 'The team at Dr. Asif Niaz Arain & Associates, Clifton' — name individuals in the caption, not the alt text

founder-portrait.label: Dr. Asif Niaz Arain, archival portrait
founder-portrait.subject: Family-approved archival photograph of Dr. Asif Niaz Arain
founder-portrait.text_safe_area: No overlay. Archival images may be black and white; do not colourise or retouch without family approval
founder-portrait.alt_guidance: 'Dr. Asif Niaz Arain' plus year if known

interior-reception.label: Reception and waiting area
interior-reception.subject: The real reception and waiting area

interior-room.label: A treatment room
interior-room.subject: A real treatment room, tidy, no patient
interior-room.alt_guidance: Describe the room; don't imply specific equipment unless confirmed

service-*.label: Treatment detail image
service-*.subject: Environment, instruments or hands-at-work detail relevant to the treatment. No before/after images and no identifiable patients
service-*.alt_guidance: Describe what is shown, not a promised result
service-*.consent_required: Written consent if any patient is visible

first-visit.label: A first-visit consultation
first-visit.subject: A clinician talking with a patient before treatment, seated upright, conversation rather than procedure
first-visit.consent_required: Written consent from the patient (or a consenting model, disclosed as such internally)

location-exterior.label: Street entrance and signage
location-exterior.subject: Street entrance and signage as a patient would see it on arrival
location-exterior.text_safe_area: No overlay; keep the door and sign central for the square crop
location-exterior.alt_guidance: 'Entrance to the clinic on <street>, Clifton Block 5' once the address is verified

location-map.label: Map at the verified location
location-map.subject: Static map or click-to-load map at the verified Google Business Profile pin
location-map.alt_guidance: 'Map showing the clinic in Clifton Block 5, Karachi' with a text address alongside
location-map.consent_required: None. Prefer a static image plus a directions link to avoid third-party tracking on load

social-share.label: Social preview image
appears_on: og:image / twitter:image for every page on the production domain
social-share.subject: Approved wordmark on ivory with one authentic clinic image
